WITH o AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_name FROM `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.d2c_orders`
  WHERE COALESCE(is_deleted,false)=false AND order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' AND order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
), r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT return_id, original_order_ref FROM `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.returns`
  WHERE rn=1 AND COALESCE(is_deleted,false)=false AND channel_code='D2C'
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) AS aug_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.original_order_ref) AS aug_orders_returned,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS returns_on_aug_orders,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(original_order_ref) FROM r) AS sample_ref,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(order_name) FROM o) AS sample_order
FROM r JOIN o ON r.original_order_ref = o.order_name
